eyebrow: Myth or fact? · خرافة أو حقيقة؟
en: After a kidney transplant, they close your fistula. Myth or fact? Answer tonight.
qar: شو قلّك فريقك عن الفيستولا تبعك؟ وشو ما حدا قلّك؟ ردّ عالستوري، بتوصل عالخاص.
qen: What did your team tell you about your fistula, and what did nobody say? Reply to this story. It comes to my DMs.
